summary: Restore locally reserved checkouts with owner fencing

delivery.outcome: Restore a missing locally reserved checkout from exact metadata under the current live local owner, without creating a new identity or changing the lease.
nonGoals: No external-controller fallback, source replay, publication or policy changes

architecture.decision: Add an explicit local reservation route; reuse anchored lease locking and canonical lease validation. Require exact lease bytes, owner CAS, scope and live phase before each restoration effect. Preserve the existing external controller route.
interfaceChanges: Explicit --restore-local-request FILE with writer identity; never infer or fall back
dataChanges: No lease changes; restore only missing own README.md and intent.json
architecture.rollback: Reviewed source revert; preserve all reservations, snapshots and restored checkouts.

validation.evidence: Disposable real Git fixtures restore the same identity, including lost branch, and resume idempotently without a controller store.
Wrong owner, stale CAS/digest, expired/frozen lease, collisions and changes between effects fail closed; external route regressions remain green.
Canonical scope and delivery validation; protected current-base/head CI and independent App review before merge.
